title: portulaca pilosa subsp. decipiens
intro: Portulaca pilosa subsp. decipiens, commonly known as 'dwarf purslane' or 'purslane of the sand', is a species of flowering plant in the family Portulacaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, and research has confirmed its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include treating fever, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems, as well as wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Portulaca pilosa subsp. decipiens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
